candidates.name: single_arm_moves
candidates.text: Only one arm carries the motion while the other arm stays still.
candidates.definition: One arm (usually the right) clearly moves while the other arm stays at the side or still, and the legs do not carry the motion.

candidates.name: both_arms_mirror
candidates.text: Both arms make the same motion at the same time, mirrored left and right.
candidates.definition: The left and right arms move together with matching, mirrored paths throughout most of the action.

candidates.name: one_hand_holds_other_works
candidates.text: One hand stays still as a base while the other hand moves near it.
candidates.definition: Both hands are close together in front of the body; one (usually left) stays nearly still while the other makes repeated or directed motions near it.

candidates.name: hands_move_arms_still
candidates.text: Small motion is at the hands and wrists while the upper arms stay still.
candidates.definition: Visible motion is mainly in the hand and wrist joints, with the elbows and shoulders nearly fixed.

candidates.name: forearm_swings_upper_arm_still
candidates.text: The forearm swings from the elbow while the upper arm stays fixed.
candidates.definition: The elbow acts as the pivot: the forearm and hand move back and forth while the upper arm barely moves.

candidates.name: head_carries_motion
candidates.text: The head is the main moving part.
candidates.definition: The largest visible motion is a movement of the head relative to the shoulders, with the arms mostly passive.

candidates.name: legs_carry_motion
candidates.text: The legs carry the main motion.
candidates.definition: The largest movement is in the knees, ankles and feet, with the arms only following or balancing.

candidates.name: one_leg_moves
candidates.text: One leg moves while the other leg supports the body.
candidates.definition: A single leg lifts and moves through the main motion while the other stays planted.

candidates.name: torso_carries_motion
candidates.text: The torso bends or turns as a main part of the motion.
candidates.definition: The spine joints move clearly (bending forward, twisting or leaning), not only as a small follow of arm motion.

candidates.name: arms_and_legs_together
candidates.text: Arms and legs move together in a coordinated way.
candidates.definition: Both the arms and the legs show large motion during the same phase of the action.

candidates.name: shoulders_move
candidates.text: The shoulders lift, roll or drop visibly.
candidates.definition: The shoulder joints move relative to the spine (shrug, roll back, drop on one side, or round inward).

candidates.name: left_arm_leads
candidates.text: The left arm carries the main motion.
candidates.definition: The left arm makes the largest or first directed movement, while the right arm is passive or only assists.

candidates.name: hand_at_mouth
candidates.text: A hand comes to the front of the mouth and stays there.
candidates.definition: The hand joint ends at or directly in front of the mouth, at the center of the face, for at least a short pause. Hands placed at the ear, forehead or top of head do not count.

candidates.name: hand_at_ear
candidates.text: A hand rests at the side of the head next to the ear.
candidates.definition: One or both hands are positioned at the side of the head at ear level, not in front of the face and not on top of the head.

candidates.name: hand_on_top_of_head
candidates.text: A hand touches the top of the head.
candidates.definition: The hand reaches the crown of the head, above the ears, at some point in the action.

candidates.name: hand_on_forehead
candidates.text: A hand touches the forehead or temple.
candidates.definition: The hand stops at the upper front or upper side of the face, above the eyes, rather than at the mouth or ear.

candidates.name: hands_on_face_both
candidates.text: Both hands touch the face at the same time.
candidates.definition: Both hand joints are at the face (eyes, nose, cheeks) together for a moment.

candidates.name: hands_touch_each_other
candidates.text: The two hands touch each other in front of the body.
candidates.definition: The right and left hand joints meet or overlap in front of the torso at some point, not counting crossed forearms where the hands are apart.

candidates.name: hand_on_opposite_arm
candidates.text: A hand rests on the other forearm or upper arm.
candidates.definition: One hand ends on the other arm (wrist, forearm or near the elbow) rather than on the other hand.

candidates.name: hand_on_chest_or_belly
candidates.text: A hand is pressed against the front of the torso.
candidates.definition: One or both hands rest on the chest or stomach area of the same person, touching the torso.

candidates.name: hand_behind_back
candidates.text: A hand reaches behind the torso to the back.
candidates.definition: A hand joint moves to a position behind the plane of the torso, at the lower or upper back.

candidates.name: hand_behind_neck
candidates.text: A hand reaches the back of the neck or back of the head.
candidates.definition: The hand passes behind the head and stops at the back of the neck or lower back of the head.

candidates.name: hand_at_own_hip
candidates.text: A hand moves to the side of the hip or upper thigh.
candidates.definition: One hand ends at or beside the same person's hip or upper thigh, not in front of the body.

candidates.name: hand_near_foot
candidates.text: A hand comes down near the foot or the floor.
candidates.definition: A hand joint lowers until it is at the height of the ankles or feet.

candidates.name: forearms_cross
candidates.text: The two forearms cross over each other in front of the body.
candidates.definition: The left and right forearms overlap in front of the chest or face so each hand is on the opposite side of the body.

candidates.name: actor_beside_or_behind_partner
candidates.text: One person stands beside or behind the other, not face to face.
candidates.definition: The actor is positioned at the side or back of the partner during the main phase, rather than facing them.

candidates.name: distance_decreases
candidates.text: The two people move closer together.
candidates.definition: The distance between the two torsos shrinks clearly during the action.

candidates.name: distance_increases
candidates.text: The two people end farther apart than they started.
candidates.definition: The distance between the two torsos grows clearly during the action, by walking away or the partner stepping back.

candidates.name: one_actor_one_reactor
candidates.text: One person acts while the other only responds or stays still.
candidates.definition: The two people have different roles: one initiates the main motion and the other receives it or reacts afterward.

candidates.name: mirrored_roles
candidates.text: Both people make the same movement at the same time.
candidates.definition: The two skeletons perform matching motions simultaneously, as mirror images of each other.

candidates.name: partner_recoils
candidates.text: The partner's body jerks or leans away from the actor.
candidates.definition: At the moment of the actor's movement, the partner's head or torso moves back or turns away suddenly.

candidates.name: partner_raises_arms_to_block
candidates.text: The partner lifts the arms in front of the head or body.
candidates.definition: The partner raises one or both arms in front of the head or chest as a guard in response to the actor.

candidates.name: contact_partner_upper_body
candidates.text: The actor's hand touches the partner's head, shoulders or chest.
candidates.definition: The actor's hand reaches the partner's upper body (head, shoulder, chest or upper back).

candidates.name: contact_partner_lower_body
candidates.text: The actor touches the partner's hip, legs or feet.
candidates.definition: The actor's hand or foot reaches the partner's body at hip level or below.

candidates.name: hands_meet_between
candidates.text: Hands of both people meet in the space between them.
candidates.definition: A hand of each person reaches forward so the two hands touch or nearly touch midway between the two bodies.

candidates.name: no_contact_at_distance
candidates.text: The two people stay apart and never touch.
candidates.definition: Throughout the action no joint of one person comes into contact with the other person.

candidates.name: move_together_same_direction
candidates.text: Both people walk in the same direction together.
candidates.definition: Both skeletons translate across the floor in the same direction at a similar speed.

candidates.name: sustained_body_contact
candidates.text: The two people stay in contact for a long time.
candidates.definition: Contact between the two bodies is held for much of the action rather than a brief touch.

candidates.name: hands_at_face_front
candidates.text: The hands are active directly in front of the face.
candidates.definition: The active hand or hands are at face height, in front of the mouth, nose or eyes, near the body's midline.

candidates.name: hands_above_head
candidates.text: The hands are active above the head.
candidates.definition: The active hands reach a height above the top of the head.

candidates.name: hands_beside_head
candidates.text: The hands are active at the sides of the head.
candidates.definition: The active hands are at head height but out to the side of the head rather than in front of the face.

candidates.name: hands_close_in_front_of_chest
candidates.text: Both hands are held close together in front of the chest.
candidates.definition: Both hands are near each other at chest height, in front of the torso near the midline.

candidates.name: hands_low_front_waist
candidates.text: The hands are active low in front of the body at waist height.
candidates.definition: The active hands are in front of the body at or below the waist, roughly at table height.

candidates.name: hands_near_floor
candidates.text: The hands are active near the floor.
candidates.definition: The active hands drop to about knee height or lower in front of the body.

candidates.name: hands_behind_body
candidates.text: The hands are active behind the body.
candidates.definition: The active hands move behind the plane of the torso (back, behind the shoulders).

candidates.name: hand_at_hip_side
candidates.text: The hand is active beside the hip.
candidates.definition: The active hand is at the side of the body at hip height, not in front of it.

candidates.name: hand_far_in_front
candidates.text: The hand reaches far out in front of the body.
candidates.definition: The active hand is held at nearly full arm length in front of the shoulder.

candidates.name: hand_raised_front_chest_to_shoulder
candidates.text: A single hand is raised in front of the body between chest and shoulder height.
candidates.definition: One hand is lifted with a bent elbow to between chest and shoulder height in front of the body, not reaching the face.

candidates.name: hand_crosses_midline
candidates.text: A hand moves across to the opposite side of the body.
candidates.definition: The active hand passes the body midline and works on the other side.

candidates.name: arms_out_to_sides
candidates.text: The arms are held or swung out to the sides of the body.
candidates.definition: The hands are clearly lateral to the shoulders, away from the torso sides.

candidates.name: raise_and_hold_arm
candidates.text: An arm is raised to a position and held still before lowering.
candidates.definition: The arm lifts to a target position, pauses there with little motion, then lowers; there is no repeated stroke during the hold.

candidates.name: arm_extends_forward
candidates.text: An arm straightens forward away from the body.
candidates.definition: The elbow extends so the hand moves forward far in front of the shoulder.

candidates.name: arms_raise_overhead
candidates.text: The arms rise until the hands are above the head.
candidates.definition: One or both hands move upward past the top of the head.

candidates.name: fast_arm_swing_arc
candidates.text: An arm swings quickly through a wide arc.
candidates.definition: The hand travels a long curved path at high speed, driven from the shoulder.

candidates.name: wrist_twist
candidates.text: The hand turns about the forearm axis.
candidates.definition: The wrist rotates so the thumb and hand tip change direction around the forearm, with little arm travel.

candidates.name: head_rotates_sideways
candidates.text: The head turns or tilts to the side.
candidates.definition: The head joint rotates left or right around the neck, or tilts toward one shoulder.

candidates.name: downward_press
candidates.text: A hand or foot pushes sharply downward.
candidates.definition: The hand or foot moves down quickly with force toward a low point and stops.

candidates.name: pull_toward_body
candidates.text: A hand pulls back toward the person's own body.
candidates.definition: After reaching out, the hand moves sharply back toward the person's own torso as a main phase of the action.

candidates.name: hands_converge
candidates.text: The two hands move toward each other and come together.
candidates.definition: The distance between the two hands shrinks during the main phase, ending with the hands close or touching.

candidates.name: hands_separate
candidates.text: The two hands start together and move apart.
candidates.definition: The hands begin close together and the distance between them grows during the main phase.

candidates.name: hand_moves_onto_head
candidates.text: The hands move to the head and settle there.
candidates.definition: The hands travel to the head and their last position on the head is reached by moving downward or backward onto it.

candidates.name: hand_moves_off_head
candidates.text: The hands start at the head and move up or forward away from it.
candidates.definition: The hands begin on the head and the main motion carries them up or forward away from the head.

candidates.name: back_and_forth_oscillation
candidates.text: A body part moves back and forth repeatedly along a short path.
candidates.definition: The hand or head moves to and fro along roughly the same short line several times.

candidates.name: circular_hand_path
candidates.text: The hands trace circles.
candidates.definition: The hand joint follows a closed, roughly round path, repeated.

candidates.name: torso_bent_forward
candidates.text: The torso bends forward from the hips.
candidates.definition: The upper spine moves clearly in front of the hips, more than a slight lean, at some point in the action.

candidates.name: head_bowed_down
candidates.text: The head tilts down toward the hands and stays down.
candidates.definition: The head stays pitched downward for most of the action, usually toward hands held in front.

candidates.name: head_tilted_back
candidates.text: The head tilts backward.
candidates.definition: The head pitches back so the face points upward relative to the torso for a moment.

candidates.name: seated
candidates.text: The person is sitting with hips at seat height.
candidates.definition: The hips are low and the thighs roughly horizontal with the feet on the floor for much of the action.

candidates.name: deep_knee_bend
candidates.text: Both knees bend deeply and the hips drop low.
candidates.definition: Both knees flex strongly so the hips come down well below standing height.

candidates.name: stand_on_one_leg
candidates.text: The body is supported on one leg while the other foot is off the floor.
candidates.definition: One foot leaves the floor and is held up while the other leg alone supports the body.

candidates.name: elbow_raised_to_side
candidates.text: The elbow is lifted out to the side at about shoulder height.
candidates.definition: The elbow joint moves out sideways from the torso and up near shoulder level.

candidates.name: shoulders_rounded_forward
candidates.text: The shoulders hunch forward and inward.
candidates.definition: Both shoulders move forward and slightly together, giving a curled upper back.

candidates.name: torso_twisted
candidates.text: The torso twists so the shoulders turn relative to the hips.
candidates.definition: The line between the shoulders rotates away from the line between the hips.

candidates.name: torso_tilted_sideways
candidates.text: The torso leans to one side.
candidates.definition: The spine tilts toward the left or right so one shoulder is clearly lower than the other.

candidates.name: hands_held_overhead
candidates.text: The hands are held at or above head height.
candidates.definition: Both or one hand stays at or above the top of the head for a held moment.

candidates.name: arm_straight_extended
candidates.text: An arm is held straight with the elbow extended.
candidates.definition: The elbow is near fully straight and the arm is held out from the body.

candidates.name: hand_tip_above_wrist
candidates.text: The raised hand is held upright with the fingertips above the wrist.
candidates.definition: While the hand is held raised, the hand-tip and thumb joints are above the wrist joint.

candidates.name: hand_tip_below_wrist
candidates.text: The hand points down with the fingertips or thumb below the wrist.
candidates.definition: While the hand is active, the hand-tip or thumb joint is clearly below the wrist joint.

candidates.name: steady_repetition
candidates.text: The same movement repeats many times at a steady rhythm.
candidates.definition: One movement cycle repeats more than three times with roughly even timing.

candidates.name: few_repetitions
candidates.text: A movement is done two or three times, then stops.
candidates.definition: A distinct stroke or beat repeats a small number of times, not continuously.

candidates.name: single_occurrence
candidates.text: The movement happens once and does not repeat.
candidates.definition: There is one main stroke or reach in the whole clip, followed by return or rest.

candidates.name: held_still_pose
candidates.text: A pose is held still for a while in the middle of the action.
candidates.definition: After the body reaches a target posture, all joints stay nearly fixed for a clear pause before returning.

candidates.name: sudden_burst
candidates.text: The main movement is sudden and very fast.
candidates.definition: The key phase is a short, abrupt burst much faster than the rest of the action.

candidates.name: slow_smooth
candidates.text: The movement is slow and smooth throughout.
candidates.definition: All phases happen at a slow, even pace without abrupt changes in speed.

candidates.name: sustained_small_motion
candidates.text: Small hand movements continue for the whole clip with little change.
candidates.definition: Low-amplitude hand motion continues throughout without a clear start-hold-end structure.

candidates.name: ends_in_new_state
candidates.text: The body ends in a different posture or place than it started.
candidates.definition: The final pose or position clearly differs from the initial one, rather than returning to the start.

candidates.name: two_sided_sequence
candidates.text: One side of the body acts, then the other side does a similar act.
candidates.definition: A movement made by one arm or side is followed by a matching movement with the other side.

candidates.name: preparatory_wind_up
candidates.text: A limb first moves backward before the main forward movement.
candidates.definition: The main fast motion is preceded by a clear opposite movement (draw back or crouch) that loads it.

candidates.name: shrug_at_end
candidates.text: The action ends with the shoulders lifting and hands pulling at the front.
candidates.definition: In the last phase the shoulders lift or bounce and the hands pull down or forward at the front of the chest or shoulders.

candidates.name: ends_with_hands_low_front
candidates.text: The action ends with both hands coming down together in front of the body.
candidates.definition: In the final phase both hands meet or come near each other in front of the body and then lower toward the waist or floor.

candidates.name: brief_meet_then_withdraw
candidates.text: Hands meet for a brief moment and then pull back.
candidates.definition: Two hands (of one or two people) come together, touch only briefly without a hold, and then separate.

candidates.name: walking_steps
candidates.text: The person walks with alternating steps across the floor.
candidates.definition: The feet alternate steps and the hips travel a clear distance over the floor.

candidates.name: stays_in_place_legs_moving
candidates.text: The legs move repeatedly but the body stays on the same spot.
candidates.definition: The legs lift or bend repeatedly while the hips do not travel across the floor.

candidates.name: both_feet_leave_floor
candidates.text: The body rises so the feet leave the floor.
candidates.definition: There is a moment when the supporting foot or feet are off the floor and the whole body is in the air.

candidates.name: body_lowers
candidates.text: The whole body lowers toward the floor.
candidates.definition: The hips move clearly downward from standing height during the main phase.

candidates.name: body_rises_from_low
candidates.text: The whole body rises from a low position to standing.
candidates.definition: The hips start low (seated or crouched) and move up to standing height during the action.

candidates.name: single_leg_support
candidates.text: The body is balanced on one leg during the main motion.
candidates.definition: For the key phase, only one foot is on the floor carrying the body weight.

candidates.name: unsteady_balance
candidates.text: The body sways or loses balance.
candidates.definition: The torso and hips wobble irregularly, or the body collapses, rather than moving in a controlled path.

candidates.name: weight_shift_forward
candidates.text: Body weight shifts from the back foot onto the front foot.
candidates.definition: The hips and torso move forward over the front foot as the main motion is delivered, while the feet stay in place.

candidates.name: whole_body_still_hands_work
candidates.text: The legs and torso stay still while only the hands and arms move.
candidates.definition: Hips, legs and torso remain nearly fixed for the whole action; all motion is in the arms or hands.

candidates.name: small_foot_adjustments
candidates.text: The feet take small adjusting steps during an otherwise upper-body action.
candidates.definition: A few small, irregular steps occur while the main motion is in the arms; the body does not travel far.

candidates.name: trunk_rotates_with_hips
candidates.text: The whole trunk turns around the vertical axis.
candidates.definition: The torso and hips rotate together to one side and back as part of the main movement.

candidates.name: right_arm_only
candidates.text: Only the right arm moves while the left arm stays still.
candidates.definition: The right arm and hand carry the motion; the left arm hangs or rests without a matching movement, and the legs do not take part.

candidates.name: both_arms_mirror
candidates.text: Both arms move together as mirror images.
candidates.definition: Left and right arms make the same movement at the same time on opposite sides of the body.

candidates.name: one_hand_holds_other_works
candidates.text: One hand stays still while the other hand works near it.
candidates.definition: Both hands are close together in front of the body; one (usually the left) stays nearly fixed while the other makes the repeated or larger movement.

candidates.name: arms_alternate_sides
candidates.text: One arm acts, then the other arm repeats the action on its side.
candidates.definition: The two arms make similar movements one after the other rather than at the same time.

candidates.name: torso_carries_motion
candidates.text: The torso bends or twists as a main part of the movement.
candidates.definition: The spine joints change angle or rotate clearly relative to the hips, not just following the arms.

candidates.name: one_leg_active
candidates.text: One leg makes the main movement while the other supports.
candidates.definition: A single leg lifts, swings or stamps while the other leg holds the body weight.

candidates.name: legs_alternate
candidates.text: The two legs move in alternation, one after the other.
candidates.definition: Left and right legs take turns lifting and supporting, as in stepping or running.

candidates.name: both_legs_flex_together
candidates.text: Both knees bend or straighten at the same time.
candidates.definition: Both legs flex or extend simultaneously, raising or lowering the hips, with both feet staying on the same footing.

candidates.name: wrist_and_hand_dominant
candidates.text: Small motions of the wrist and hand, with the arm nearly still.
candidates.definition: Movement is concentrated at the hand and hand tip joints; the elbow and shoulder change little.

candidates.name: forearm_swings_upper_arm_still
candidates.text: The forearm swings at the elbow while the upper arm stays still.
candidates.definition: The elbow joint stays roughly fixed and the forearm and hand move back and forth around it.

candidates.name: whole_arm_from_shoulder
candidates.text: The whole straight arm moves widely from the shoulder.
candidates.definition: The arm moves as a long lever about the shoulder, so the hand travels a large distance with the elbow mostly straight.

candidates.name: hand_to_mouth_or_nose
candidates.text: A hand comes to the front of the mouth or nose.
candidates.definition: At least one hand tip or wrist ends at or just in front of the mouth or nose, centered on the face, and stays there for at least a short moment.

candidates.name: hand_to_ear_region
candidates.text: A hand comes to the side of the head next to the ear.
candidates.definition: A hand ends beside the head at ear height, lateral to the face rather than in front of it.

candidates.name: hand_on_top_of_head
candidates.text: A hand rests on or moves over the top of the head.
candidates.definition: A hand reaches the crown of the head, above the level of the ears, and touches or nearly touches it.

candidates.name: hand_to_forehead_or_temple
candidates.text: A hand touches the forehead or the temple.
candidates.definition: A hand ends at the upper part of the face, above the eyes, at the front or at the side of the forehead.

candidates.name: hands_touch_each_other
candidates.text: The two hands of the same person meet and touch.
candidates.definition: The left and right hand joints come into contact or nearly so in front of the body for at least part of the action.

candidates.name: forearms_cross
candidates.text: The two forearms cross over each other in front of the body.
candidates.definition: Each hand ends on the opposite side of the body midline so the forearms overlap in front of the chest or face.

candidates.name: hand_on_own_chest_or_belly
candidates.text: A hand presses on the front of the own chest or belly.
candidates.definition: A hand rests on the front surface of the torso, between the shoulders and the hips, and stays there.

candidates.name: hand_at_own_hip_or_back
candidates.text: A hand goes to the side of the hip or behind the lower back.
candidates.definition: A hand ends at the outside of the hip, the upper thigh, or behind the torso near the waist.

candidates.name: hand_to_own_foot
candidates.text: A hand reaches down to touch the own foot or ankle.
candidates.definition: A hand comes to the foot or ankle joint of the same person, which requires the torso to bend or the leg to lift.

candidates.name: head_moves_to_hand
candidates.text: The head bends toward a raised hand to close the gap.
candidates.definition: While a hand is held near the face, the head moves forward or down toward it rather than only the hand moving to the head.

candidates.name: face_to_face
candidates.text: The two people stand facing each other.
candidates.definition: The front of each torso points toward the other person for most of the action.

candidates.name: side_by_side_or_behind
candidates.text: One person stands beside or behind the other.
candidates.definition: The actor is at the side of or behind the partner, so the partner's torso does not face the actor.

candidates.name: hands_meet_between
candidates.text: A hand of each person meets in the space between them.
candidates.definition: Both people extend a hand forward and the two hands touch or nearly touch at a point midway between their bodies.

candidates.name: hit_partner_body
candidates.text: One person's hand or foot hits the other's body quickly.
candidates.definition: A fast-moving hand, arm or foot of the actor reaches the partner's head, torso or legs and stops there briefly.

candidates.name: partner_recoils
candidates.text: The partner's body jerks or steps back away from the actor.
candidates.definition: The partner's head or torso moves suddenly away from the actor, or the partner steps backward, in response to the actor's movement.

candidates.name: partner_raises_arms_to_block
candidates.text: The partner lifts the arms in front of the head or body.
candidates.definition: The partner's hands rise quickly to in front of the face or chest, or up beside the head, in response to the actor.

candidates.name: arm_aimed_without_contact
candidates.text: The actor aims an arm or hands at the partner without touching.
candidates.definition: The actor holds an arm or both hands directed at the partner from a distance, with no contact between their bodies.

candidates.name: distance_shrinks
candidates.text: The two people move closer together.
candidates.definition: The distance between the two torsos decreases clearly over the clip because one or both move toward the other.

candidates.name: distance_grows
candidates.text: The two people end farther apart than they started.
candidates.definition: The distance between the two torsos increases clearly over the clip.

candidates.name: prolonged_body_contact
candidates.text: The two bodies stay in contact for a long time.
candidates.definition: Arms or torsos of the two people stay touching for most of the clip, not just a brief touch.

candidates.name: travel_together
candidates.text: Both people walk in the same direction.
candidates.definition: Both people take steps and their bodies move across the floor in the same direction at a similar pace.

candidates.name: both_do_same_motion
candidates.text: Both people make the same movement at the same time.
candidates.definition: The two skeletons perform matching movements together rather than one acting and the other reacting.

candidates.name: partner_stays_passive
candidates.text: One person acts while the other stands mostly still.
candidates.definition: Only the actor makes a clear movement; the partner's joints barely move and show no strong reaction.

candidates.name: hands_above_head
candidates.text: The hands are active above the head.
candidates.definition: During the main phase at least one hand is higher than the head joint.

candidates.name: hands_at_head_level
candidates.text: The hands are active at the level of the face and head.
candidates.definition: During the main phase at least one hand is between chin and crown height, close to the head.

candidates.name: hands_at_chest_front
candidates.text: The hands are active in front of the chest.
candidates.definition: During the main phase the hands are in front of the torso between the shoulders and the lower ribs, with elbows bent.

candidates.name: hands_at_waist_front
candidates.text: The hands are active low in front of the waist.
candidates.definition: During the main phase the hands are in front of the body at about hip or waist height, below the chest.

candidates.name: hands_near_floor
candidates.text: The hands reach down near the floor.
candidates.definition: During the main phase at least one hand is lower than the knees, close to the feet or floor.

candidates.name: hands_behind_body
candidates.text: The hands move behind the back or shoulders.
candidates.definition: At least one hand passes behind the plane of the torso during the main phase.

candidates.name: hand_at_hip_side
candidates.text: A hand is active at the side of the hip.
candidates.definition: During the main phase a hand is next to the outside of the hip or upper thigh, not in front of the body.

candidates.name: hand_far_in_front
candidates.text: A hand is far out in front of the body.
candidates.definition: During the main phase a hand is at nearly full arm's length forward of the shoulder.

candidates.name: hands_out_to_sides
candidates.text: The hands are held out to the sides of the body.
candidates.definition: During the main phase the hands are lateral to the shoulders, away from the body midline.

candidates.name: hand_crosses_midline
candidates.text: A hand moves across to the opposite side of the body.
candidates.definition: At least one hand ends clearly on the other side of the body midline from its own shoulder.

candidates.name: arms_hang_at_sides
candidates.text: The arms hang at the sides throughout.
candidates.definition: The hands stay near the thighs for the whole action, at most swinging loosely with the steps, and never rise toward the chest or head.

candidates.name: raise_and_hold
candidates.text: The arm rises to a pose, holds it still, then lowers.
candidates.definition: An arm moves to a target position and the hand stays nearly motionless there for a clear pause before returning.

candidates.name: arm_extends_forward
candidates.text: The arm straightens forward away from the chest.
candidates.definition: The elbow extends so the hand moves forward from the body toward a point in front, ending with the arm nearly straight.

candidates.name: arms_raise_overhead
candidates.text: One or both arms lift until the hands are above the head.
candidates.definition: The hand moves upward past the head joint and ends higher than the top of the head.

candidates.name: fast_arm_swing_arc
candidates.text: The arm swings quickly through a wide arc.
candidates.definition: After drawing back, the arm moves rapidly along a curved path across or in front of the body, often with torso rotation.

candidates.name: leg_swings_out
candidates.text: One leg swings quickly forward or sideways with the knee straightening.
candidates.definition: A leg lifts off the floor and extends rapidly away from the body before returning.

candidates.name: back_and_forth_oscillation
candidates.text: The hand moves back and forth along a short line many times.
candidates.definition: A hand repeatedly reverses direction along roughly the same short straight path, without holding still between strokes.

candidates.name: twisting_rotation
candidates.text: A body part twists around its own long axis.
candidates.definition: The head, forearm or torso rotates in place rather than moving to a new location, seen as turning of the joints around the limb or spine axis.

candidates.name: circular_path
candidates.text: The hand travels in repeated circles.
candidates.definition: The hand traces a closed loop and repeats it, rather than moving back and forth along a line.

candidates.name: downward_press
candidates.text: The hand pushes downward from above.
candidates.definition: The hand or foot moves sharply down onto a point below it and stops, as a press or stamp.

candidates.name: pull_back_toward_body
candidates.text: The hand pulls back toward the own body.
candidates.definition: After reaching out, the hand returns toward the torso with a clear pulling movement, not a slow relaxed lowering.

candidates.name: hands_move_apart
candidates.text: The two hands start together and move apart.
candidates.definition: The distance between the two hands grows during the main part of the action.

candidates.name: hands_move_together
candidates.text: The two hands start apart and come together.
candidates.definition: The distance between the two hands shrinks until they meet or nearly meet in front of the body.

candidates.name: quick_flick
candidates.text: A short, fast snap of the hand.
candidates.definition: The hand makes one or two very brief rapid movements, mostly at the wrist, then stops.

candidates.name: stroke_along_surface
candidates.text: The hand slides along a body surface.
candidates.definition: The hand stays in contact with the head, face or other hand while sliding across it.

candidates.name: torso_bent_forward
candidates.text: The torso bends forward from the hips.
candidates.definition: The spine leans clearly forward of the hips for part of the action, more than a slight lean.

candidates.name: head_bowed_down
candidates.text: The head is tilted down toward the hands.
candidates.definition: The head stays pitched forward and down, as when looking at the hands or the floor, for most of the action.

candidates.name: head_tilted_back
candidates.text: The head tips backward.
candidates.definition: The head pitches back so the face points upward for a moment.

candidates.name: head_tilted_sideways
candidates.text: The head leans toward one shoulder.
candidates.definition: The head rolls to one side so one ear moves closer to the shoulder, for at least part of the action.

candidates.name: seated
candidates.text: The person sits with hips low and thighs roughly level.
candidates.definition: For most of the clip the hips are at about knee height with knees bent and feet on the floor, without the torso being bent down to the floor.

candidates.name: deep_crouch
candidates.text: Knees and hips bend deeply with the feet flat.
candidates.definition: The hips drop close to the heels or knees while the feet stay on the floor, without a seat under the hips.

candidates.name: elbow_raised_high
candidates.text: An elbow is raised to shoulder height or above.
candidates.definition: The elbow joint is at or above the level of the shoulder joint while the hand works near the head.

candidates.name: arm_fully_straight
candidates.text: An arm is held fully straight at the elbow.
candidates.definition: The shoulder, elbow and wrist line up in a straight line for a clear part of the action.

candidates.name: one_foot_off_ground
candidates.text: One foot is lifted off the floor while the other supports.
candidates.definition: One foot joint rises clearly above floor level while the other leg holds the weight.

candidates.name: torso_twisted
candidates.text: The shoulders turn relative to the hips.
candidates.definition: The line between the shoulders rotates away from the line between the hips for part of the action.

candidates.name: torso_tilted_sideways
candidates.text: The torso leans to one side.
candidates.definition: The spine tilts left or right so one shoulder drops lower than the other.

candidates.name: shoulders_hunched
candidates.text: The shoulders round inward and the head drops.
candidates.definition: The shoulders move forward and together while the upper torso curls and the head lowers, held for a while.

candidates.name: body_ends_on_ground
candidates.text: The body ends low on the floor.
candidates.definition: At the end the hips are at floor level, kneeling, sitting on the floor or lying, and they stay there.

candidates.name: many_rhythmic_repeats
candidates.text: The same short movement repeats many times at a steady rhythm.
candidates.definition: A movement cycle repeats more than three times in a row with roughly even timing.

candidates.name: few_repeats
candidates.text: The movement is done two or three times.
candidates.definition: A distinct stroke repeats a small number of times, with a short pause or adjustment between repeats.

candidates.name: single_occurrence
candidates.text: The main movement happens once.
candidates.definition: The key stroke is made once and is not repeated before the person returns to rest.

candidates.name: reach_hold_return
candidates.text: A pose is reached, held still for a while, then released.
candidates.definition: There is a clear still phase in the middle of the action between a going phase and a returning phase.

candidates.name: sudden_fast_burst
candidates.text: A sudden, very fast movement.
candidates.definition: The main movement is much faster than the movements before and after it and lasts only a short moment.

candidates.name: slow_smooth
candidates.text: The movement is slow and smooth.
candidates.definition: All joints move gradually without fast phases, with no sudden starts or stops.

candidates.name: ends_in_new_state
candidates.text: The body ends in a different posture or place than it started.
candidates.definition: The last frames differ clearly from the first frames in posture or position; the person does not return to the start.

candidates.name: one_side_then_other
candidates.text: The movement is done on one side, then on the other side.
candidates.definition: A movement made by one arm or on one side of the body is followed by a matching movement on the other side.

candidates.name: sustained_fine_activity
candidates.text: Small hand movements continue through the whole clip.
candidates.definition: The hands keep making small motions for most of the clip while the arms and body stay still, without a clear start-stroke-end.

candidates.name: irregular_jerks
candidates.text: The body moves in uneven jerks or wobbles.
candidates.definition: Movements come at irregular intervals with sudden small jolts or unsteady sway rather than a steady rhythm.

candidates.name: windup_then_release
candidates.text: A limb first draws back, then moves fast the opposite way.
candidates.definition: A preparatory backward or downward movement is followed directly by a fast movement in the opposite direction.

candidates.name: walks_across_floor
candidates.text: The person walks so the body travels across the floor.
candidates.definition: The hips move a clear distance horizontally through a series of alternating steps.

candidates.name: steps_in_place
candidates.text: The feet keep lifting and landing without the body traveling.
candidates.definition: The feet leave and return to the floor repeatedly while the hips stay over the same spot.

candidates.name: both_feet_leave_ground
candidates.text: The whole body is in the air for a moment.
candidates.definition: Both feet are off the floor at the same time, so the hips rise above their standing height.

candidates.name: hips_lower
candidates.text: The hips move down toward the floor.
candidates.definition: The hip joints drop clearly from standing height during the action, by bending the knees.

candidates.name: hips_rise
candidates.text: The hips rise up from a low position.
candidates.definition: The hip joints move up from a low, bent-knee position toward standing height.

candidates.name: loses_balance
candidates.text: The body loses balance and sways or tips over.
candidates.definition: The torso moves outside the base of the feet in an uncontrolled way, with uneven steps, sway or a fall.

candidates.name: stands_on_one_leg
candidates.text: The body is balanced on one leg.
candidates.definition: For part of the action all body weight is on one foot while the other foot is off the floor.

candidates.name: weight_shifts_between_feet
candidates.text: Body weight shifts from the back foot to the front foot.
candidates.definition: The hips move from over one foot toward the other foot while both feet stay on the floor.

candidates.name: small_vertical_bounce
candidates.text: The whole body bobs up and down a little.
candidates.definition: The hips and head rise and fall slightly in repeated small bounces, with knees flexing.

candidates.name: body_turns_around
candidates.text: The body turns to face a new direction.
candidates.definition: The hips and shoulders rotate together about the vertical axis by a large amount, changing the facing direction.

candidates.name: body_stays_still
candidates.text: The legs and torso stay still while only arms or head move.
candidates.definition: The hips, knees and torso show almost no movement for the whole clip; only the arms, hands or head move.

candidates.name: right_arm_only
candidates.text: Only the right arm moves while the rest of the body stays still.
candidates.definition: The right shoulder, elbow, wrist and hand carry all of the motion; the left arm, head, torso and legs show little movement.

candidates.name: both_arms_symmetric
candidates.text: Both arms move together in mirror-image paths.
candidates.definition: The left and right arms perform the same motion at the same time, mirrored across the body midline.

candidates.name: asymmetric_two_hand_roles
candidates.text: Both hands are used, but one holds still while the other moves.
candidates.definition: Both hands are raised in front of the body; one hand stays mostly fixed while the other makes the main movements around or onto it.

candidates.name: wrist_driven_motion
candidates.text: The motion comes mainly from the wrist and hand with little arm movement.
candidates.definition: The hand and hand-tip joints move noticeably while the elbow and shoulder stay nearly fixed.

candidates.name: forearm_swing_upper_arm_still
candidates.text: The forearm swings at the elbow while the upper arm stays fixed.
candidates.definition: The elbow bends and unbends repeatedly, moving the forearm and hand, while the shoulder and upper arm keep their position.

candidates.name: straight_arm_from_shoulder
candidates.text: The arm stays straight and moves from the shoulder.
candidates.definition: The elbow stays mostly extended while the whole arm rotates at the shoulder to raise, sweep, or circle the hand.

candidates.name: head_carries_motion
candidates.text: The head is the main moving part.
candidates.definition: The largest movement is at the head joint relative to the neck and shoulders, with the arms mostly at the sides.

candidates.name: torso_carries_motion
candidates.text: The torso bends or turns as a main part of the action.
candidates.definition: The spine joints change angle substantially (bending forward, leaning, or twisting), not just following a moving arm.

candidates.name: legs_carry_motion
candidates.text: The legs make the main movement.
candidates.definition: The knees, ankles and feet show the largest motion, through stepping, bending, kicking, or jumping.

candidates.name: single_leg_active
candidates.text: One leg lifts and moves while the other leg supports the body.
candidates.definition: One leg leaves the floor and moves forward, sideways, or down while the other leg stays planted, not alternating.

candidates.name: arm_with_torso_rotation
candidates.text: An arm moves together with a twist of the torso.
candidates.definition: While the arm swings or reaches, the shoulders turn relative to the hips, so the torso rotation adds to the arm path.

candidates.name: hands_and_head_together
candidates.text: Both the hands and the head are engaged, with the head bent toward the hands.
candidates.definition: The hands are held together in front of the body and the head bends down toward them for most of the action.

candidates.name: hand_near_mouth
candidates.text: A hand comes up to the mouth and stays close to it.
candidates.definition: The hand joint reaches the front of the lower face at mouth level and remains there for at least a short moment. Count it when the hand is in front of the mouth, not beside the ear or on top of the head.

candidates.name: hand_near_nose_or_face_center
candidates.text: One or both hands touch the middle of the face around the nose or eyes.
candidates.definition: A hand is at the center of the face above the mouth level, around the nose or eyes. Hands at the sides of the head or at the mouth do not count.

candidates.name: hand_on_top_of_head
candidates.text: A hand is placed on the top of the head.
candidates.definition: The hand joint reaches the crown of the head, above the ears. Count it when the hand rests on or moves over the top of the head.

candidates.name: hand_at_side_of_head
candidates.text: A hand touches the side of the head near the ear or temple.
candidates.definition: The hand joint is beside the head at ear or temple level, touching or nearly touching it. Hands in front of the face or on the crown do not count.

candidates.name: hand_at_back_of_neck
candidates.text: A hand reaches behind the head to the back of the neck.
candidates.definition: The hand joint moves behind the head and stays near the neck from the back, with the elbow pointing forward or up.

candidates.name: both_hands_touching
candidates.text: The two hands touch each other in front of the body.
candidates.definition: The left and right hand joints come into contact in front of the torso, either once or repeatedly. Hands that are only near each other with a gap do not count.

candidates.name: active_hand_meets_still_hand
candidates.text: One hand stays still while the other hand repeatedly moves to it.
candidates.definition: One hand (usually the left) holds a fixed position and the other hand moves onto, across, or around it. The two hands play different roles.

candidates.name: hand_on_chest
candidates.text: A hand or forearm is pressed against the front of the chest.
candidates.definition: A hand or forearm rests on the torso at chest level and stays there. Hands held in front of the chest with space between them and the body do not count.

candidates.name: hand_on_hip_or_lower_back
candidates.text: A hand is placed at the hip, upper thigh, or lower back.
candidates.definition: The hand joint moves to the side of the hip, the upper thigh, or the lower back and stays there briefly or for longer.

candidates.name: hands_reach_foot
candidates.text: The hands reach down to touch a foot.
candidates.definition: One or both hand joints come close to an ankle or foot joint. Hands near the floor but away from the feet do not count.

candidates.name: forearms_cross
candidates.text: The two forearms cross or overlap in front of the body.
candidates.definition: The left and right forearms pass over each other in front of the chest or face so each hand ends on the opposite side of the body, or one hand holds the other wrist or arm.

candidates.name: head_moves_toward_hand
candidates.text: The head moves down or forward to meet a raised hand.
candidates.definition: While a hand is held near the face, the head dips or bends toward it, reducing the distance between head and hand from the head side.

candidates.name: face_to_face
candidates.text: The two people stand facing each other.
candidates.definition: The fronts of both torsos point toward each other during the main phase.

candidates.name: side_or_behind_partner
candidates.text: One person stands beside or behind the other.
candidates.definition: One person is next to or behind the partner, facing the partner's side or back rather than the front.

candidates.name: hands_meet_between
candidates.text: The hands of both people meet in the space between them.
candidates.definition: A hand of each person reaches forward and the hands come together between the two bodies.

candidates.name: fast_strike_to_partner
candidates.text: The actor moves a limb quickly into the partner's body.
candidates.definition: An arm or leg of one person travels quickly toward the partner and reaches the head, torso, or legs of the partner.

candidates.name: partner_recoils
candidates.text: The partner jerks back, leans away, or steps back in reaction.
candidates.definition: Right after the actor's movement, the partner's head or torso moves away from the actor, or the partner steps backward.

candidates.name: partner_raises_arms_to_block
candidates.text: The partner raises the arms in front of the body or head.
candidates.definition: The partner lifts one or both arms in front of the head or chest in response to the actor.

candidates.name: distance_decreases
candidates.text: The two people move closer together.
candidates.definition: The distance between the two bodies shrinks over the action.

candidates.name: distance_increases
candidates.text: The two people move apart.
candidates.definition: The distance between the two bodies grows over the action.

candidates.name: walk_same_direction
candidates.text: Both people walk in the same direction.
candidates.definition: Both people take steps and travel the same way while keeping a similar distance between them.

candidates.name: torsos_in_contact
candidates.text: The two bodies are pressed close with arms around each other.
candidates.definition: The torsos are touching or nearly touching and at least one arm wraps around the other person's back, shoulders, or waist.

candidates.name: both_do_same_motion
candidates.text: Both people perform the same movement at the same time.
candidates.definition: The two skeletons show matching movements in parallel, rather than one acting and the other reacting.

candidates.name: no_contact_at_distance
candidates.text: The two people stay apart without touching.
candidates.definition: Throughout the action no joint of one person comes close to the other person's body.

candidates.name: hands_at_face_front
candidates.text: The hands are active in front of the face.
candidates.definition: The main hand activity takes place in front of the face, between chin and forehead, not beside or above the head.

candidates.name: hands_above_head
candidates.text: The hands are active above the head.
candidates.definition: The hand joints are higher than the top of the head during the main phase.

candidates.name: hands_on_head
candidates.text: The hands are active on the top or sides of the head.
candidates.definition: The hands touch the scalp area, from the crown down to the ears or temples, during the main phase.

candidates.name: hands_beside_head_away
candidates.text: A hand is held beside the head but not touching it.
candidates.definition: The hand is at head or shoulder height out to the side or in front of the shoulder, with space between the hand and the head.

candidates.name: hands_in_front_of_chest
candidates.text: The hands are active in front of the chest.
candidates.definition: The main hand activity takes place in front of the chest, roughly between shoulder and lower rib height.

candidates.name: hands_at_waist_front
candidates.text: The hands are active low in front of the body at waist height.
candidates.definition: The hands work at about waist or table height in front of the hips, below the chest.

candidates.name: hands_near_floor
candidates.text: The hands reach down near the floor or feet.
candidates.definition: The hand joints get close to the height of the feet during the main phase.

candidates.name: hands_behind_body
candidates.text: The hands move behind the back.
candidates.definition: One or both hand joints go behind the plane of the torso, at the back, lower back, or behind the shoulder.

candidates.name: hand_at_hip_side
candidates.text: A hand is active at the side of the hip.
candidates.definition: The hand is beside the hip or upper thigh, not in front of the body center.

candidates.name: arm_extended_far_forward
candidates.text: The hand is far out from the body with the arm extended.
candidates.definition: The hand reaches a position well away from the torso, near full arm length, in front or to the side.

candidates.name: hands_cross_body_midline
candidates.text: A hand crosses to the opposite side of the body.
candidates.definition: A hand moves past the body center line to the opposite side, in front of the chest or toward the opposite foot or shoulder.

candidates.name: hand_at_neck
candidates.text: A hand is active at the neck.
candidates.definition: The hand stays near the neck joint, at the front, side, or back.

candidates.name: raise_and_hold_arm
candidates.text: An arm is raised to a position and held still before lowering.
candidates.definition: The arm lifts to a target position, the hand stays nearly still there for a moment, and then the arm lowers. No repeated motion during the hold.

candidates.name: fast_forward_arm_swing
candidates.text: The arm is drawn back and then swung quickly forward.
candidates.definition: The hand first moves back behind or above the shoulder, then travels quickly forward or forward-down in one fast stroke.

candidates.name: horizontal_arm_sweep
candidates.text: The arm sweeps sideways in a wide horizontal arc.
candidates.definition: The hand moves across the front of the body roughly at a constant height, from one side to the other, with the arm extended.

candidates.name: two_arm_forward_push
candidates.text: Both arms extend forward together from bent elbows.
candidates.definition: Both elbows start bent with hands near the chest or low in front, then both arms straighten forward at the same time.

candidates.name: upward_arm_extension
candidates.text: The arms extend upward until the hands are above the head.
candidates.definition: The hands rise past the face and the elbows straighten so the hands end above the head.

candidates.name: pull_hand_back_to_body
candidates.text: The hand reaches out and is then pulled back toward the body.
candidates.definition: After extending away from the torso, the hand returns toward the actor's own chest or mouth in a clear withdrawing movement.

candidates.name: downward_press
candidates.text: A hand pushes downward onto the other hand or a low point.
candidates.definition: The hand moves down with a short pressing stroke, often with the shoulders over it, and may rise and press again.

candidates.name: rubbing_strokes
candidates.text: A hand slides back and forth repeatedly against a surface of the body.
candidates.definition: The hand stays in contact with the face, head, neck or other hand while making short repeated sliding strokes.

candidates.name: wrist_rotation
candidates.text: The wrist turns so the hand rotates about the forearm.
candidates.definition: The hand and thumb joints rotate around the forearm axis, once or repeatedly, with the arm otherwise steady.

candidates.name: side_to_side_oscillation
candidates.text: A body part moves left and right repeatedly.
candidates.definition: The hand, forearm, or head moves back and forth sideways several times around a fixed center point.

candidates.name: circular_motion
candidates.text: The hands trace circles.
candidates.definition: The hand path closes on itself in a loop, repeated several times, either around the shoulder or over a small area.

candidates.name: leg_kick_extension
candidates.text: One leg swings and straightens quickly away from the body.
candidates.definition: The knee bends to draw the leg back or up, then straightens quickly so the foot moves forward or sideways away from the hips.

candidates.name: hands_move_apart
candidates.text: The two hands separate from each other.
candidates.definition: Starting close together, the two hands move away from each other sideways, outward, or backward along the head.

candidates.name: hands_move_together
candidates.text: The two hands converge toward each other.
candidates.definition: The hands start apart and move toward each other until they meet or nearly meet in front of the body.

candidates.name: single_quick_flick
candidates.text: A hand makes one short, fast flick.
candidates.definition: The hand moves in one sudden short stroke, mainly at the wrist or forearm, and does not repeat many times.

candidates.name: torso_bends_forward
candidates.text: The torso bends forward from the hips.
candidates.definition: The upper spine and neck move forward and down in front of the hips, clearly more than a slight lean.

candidates.name: deep_knee_hip_bend
candidates.text: Both knees and hips bend deeply, lowering the hips.
candidates.definition: The hip joints drop well below standing height because both knees and hips flex, as in a squat, crouch, or sitting.

candidates.name: seated_posture
candidates.text: The person is seated with hips low and knees bent.
candidates.definition: For most of the action the hips are at seat height with thighs roughly horizontal, and the legs do not move much.

candidates.name: head_tilted_down
candidates.text: The head is tilted down toward the hands or floor.
candidates.definition: The head joint is lowered forward relative to the neck and stays that way for much of the action.

candidates.name: head_tilted_back
candidates.text: The head tilts backward, face turning up.
candidates.definition: The head joint moves back relative to the neck so the face points upward, during part of the action.

candidates.name: torso_leans_back
candidates.text: The upper body leans backward.
candidates.definition: The shoulders move behind the hips so the spine tilts back, at least briefly.

candidates.name: elbow_raised_to_side
candidates.text: The elbow is raised out to the side near shoulder height.
candidates.definition: The elbow joint moves away from the torso sideways and up, roughly to shoulder level, while the hand is near the head or face.

candidates.name: arms_raised_overhead
candidates.text: Both arms are raised with hands at or above head height.
candidates.definition: Both hand joints are at or above the head for part of the action.

candidates.name: shoulders_hunched
candidates.text: The shoulders round inward and the upper body curls.
candidates.definition: The shoulder joints come forward and inward toward the chest, with the head often dropping.

candidates.name: torso_twisted
candidates.text: The shoulders turn relative to the hips.
candidates.definition: The line between the shoulders rotates away from the line between the hips at some point in the action.

candidates.name: torso_tilts_sideways
candidates.text: The upper body leans to one side.
candidates.definition: The spine tilts left or right so one shoulder is clearly lower than the other.

candidates.name: single_leg_stance
candidates.text: The body stands on one leg while the other foot is off the floor.
candidates.definition: For part of the action only one foot supports the body while the other is lifted, not as part of normal walking.

candidates.name: forearms_horizontal_at_chest
candidates.text: A forearm is held horizontal across the front of the chest.
candidates.definition: One or both forearms lie roughly level in front of the chest, crossing toward the opposite side.

candidates.name: body_ends_low
candidates.text: The body ends lowered near the floor and stays down.
candidates.definition: At the end of the action the hips and torso are much lower than standing and remain there.

candidates.name: steady_repetition
candidates.text: The same movement repeats many times at a steady rhythm.
candidates.definition: A movement cycle is performed several times in a row with similar timing between cycles.

candidates.name: single_occurrence
candidates.text: The movement happens once and does not repeat.
candidates.definition: There is one main movement phase between the start and end rest positions, with no repeated cycles.

candidates.name: sudden_onset
candidates.text: The main movement starts suddenly and is very fast.
candidates.definition: The joints accelerate sharply at the start of the main phase, giving a short burst rather than a smooth gradual motion.

candidates.name: held_still_pose
candidates.text: A pose is held still for a while in the middle of the action.
candidates.definition: After moving into position, the joints stay nearly motionless for a noticeable time before moving back.

candidates.name: slow_gradual_motion
candidates.text: The movement is slow and gradual.
candidates.definition: Joints move at low speed without sharp changes, so the main phase takes a long time.

candidates.name: returns_to_start_pose
candidates.text: The body returns to the same pose it started in.
candidates.definition: The final joint configuration is close to the initial one, after one outward-and-back movement.

candidates.name: ends_in_new_state
candidates.text: The body ends in a different pose or place from where it began.
candidates.definition: The final posture or position differs clearly from the start, such as standing to sitting, standing to lying, or a change of location.

candidates.name: alternating_sides
candidates.text: The movement is done on one side and then the other.
candidates.definition: A movement made by one limb or toward one side is followed by the matching movement with the other limb or toward the other side.

candidates.name: continuous_small_movements
candidates.text: The hands keep making small movements throughout the action.
candidates.definition: For most of the action the hands make low-amplitude movements without a clear start and end of a single stroke, while the body stays still.

candidates.name: short_jerks
candidates.text: The body makes one or a few short jerking movements.
candidates.definition: The head or upper torso moves abruptly forward or back in brief bursts, separated by stillness.

candidates.name: prolonged_hold
candidates.text: The key position is held for a long time, most of the clip.
candidates.definition: The hands or body stay in the main position for most of the clip, with only small adjustments, rather than a brief pause.

candidates.name: walking_locomotion
candidates.text: The person walks, moving the whole body to a new place.
candidates.definition: The feet take several alternating steps and the hips travel across the floor.

candidates.name: airborne_phase
candidates.text: Both feet leave the ground at some moment.
candidates.definition: At least once, no foot supports the body, as in a jump or hop.

candidates.name: repeated_in_place_leg_cycles
candidates.text: The legs repeat a cycle while the body stays in one spot.
candidates.definition: The legs lift or bounce repeatedly but the hips do not travel across the floor.

candidates.name: hips_lower_vertically
candidates.text: The hips move down toward the floor in a controlled way.
candidates.definition: The hip joints drop noticeably as both knees bend, with the feet staying in place, and the movement is not a fall.

candidates.name: hips_rise_to_standing
candidates.text: The body rises from low hips to standing.
candidates.definition: The hip joints move upward as the knees straighten, ending in a standing posture.

candidates.name: uncontrolled_fall
candidates.text: The body drops quickly and loses support.
candidates.definition: The hips and torso go down fast and do not stop at seat height; the body ends low on the floor.

candidates.name: weight_shift_between_legs
candidates.text: Body weight shifts from one leg to the other.
candidates.definition: The hips move clearly over one foot and then the other, or from the back leg to the front leg, during the action.

candidates.name: standing_on_one_leg
candidates.text: The body is supported on one leg for part of the action.
candidates.definition: One foot leaves the floor and the other foot alone carries the body for a noticeable time.

candidates.name: unsteady_sway
candidates.text: The body sways or staggers unsteadily.
candidates.definition: The torso and hips wobble sideways or forward and back in an irregular way, and steps may be uneven.

candidates.name: steps_backward
candidates.text: The person takes one or more steps backward.
candidates.definition: A foot moves behind the body and the hips follow, moving the body backward.

candidates.name: whole_body_bounce
candidates.text: The whole body bounces up and down.
candidates.definition: The hips and head rise and fall together in short vertical movements, through knee bending or hopping.

candidates.name: upper_body_only_feet_planted
candidates.text: Only the upper body moves; the feet and hips stay fixed.
candidates.definition: The ankle, knee and hip joints stay in place for the whole action while the arms, head, or torso move.
